description: This file contains the implementation of a custom JSON serialization binder for Orleans, which resolves types using a TypeResolver and inherits from DefaultSerializationBinder. It provides a constructor to set the TypeResolver and overrides the BindToType method to handle type resolution.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializationBinder
classes.description: A custom JSON serialization binder that resolves types using a provided TypeResolver.

methods.name: OrleansJsonSerializationBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the binder with a TypeResolver.

methods.name: BindToType
methods.description: Overrides the base method to resolve types using the TypeResolver before falling back to default behavior.

methods.name: BindToType
methods.description: Resolves the type based on assembly and type name, using the TypeResolver if possible.
